spans.s: शिपि (I) m. A ray of light.
शिपि-विष्ट (II) m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. of Viṣṇu; 3. a leper; 4. a bald man; 5. a man without prepuce. (Also शिपविष्ट and शिविपिष्ट in these senses.)
शिप्र m. Name of a lake on the Himālaya.
शिप्रा f. Name of a river which flows by Ujjayinī, शिप्रावातः प्रियतम इव प्रार्थनाचाटुकारः Megh.i.31.
सिप्र m. 1. Perspiration, sweat; 2. the moon.
सिप्रा f. 1. A woman’s zone; 2. a female buffalo; 3. a river near Ujjayinī, सिप्रा- (v.l.) वातः प्रियतम इव प्रार्थनाचाटुकारः Megh.i.31.
सीप m. A sacrificial vessel in the shape of a boat.
